name: Shizukana Kyandi
source:
It’s a beautiful day outside today...

I was walking down the road, the usual road of my hometown.

I come down this road in the square when I’m hungry for a treat.

Today, my stomach was growling for some food. Although I wasn’t sure what I wanted to eat.

I could envision three treats in my mind...

A delicious lemon cake... from Lemon’s Bakery.

A sweet strawberry pie... from Strawberi’s Pies.

Lastly, a savory bowl of tonkotsu ramen with additional toppings... from Ramune’s Ramen.

I can’t pick... all three of them just sound too good right now!

I’ll ask you... the monster in my brain... What should I eat on this beautiful day?
translation:
今天外面是美好的一天…

我走在家乡的小路上，那是一条平常的路。

当我饿了想吃点东西时，我会沿着广场上的这条路走来。

今天，我的肚子咕咕叫，想吃点东西。虽然我不确定自己想吃什么。

我可以在脑海中想象三种款待……

美味的柠檬蛋糕……来自柠檬面包店。

甜甜的草莓派……来自Strawberi's Pies。

最后，一碗美味的猪骨拉面，还有额外的配料……来自Ramune’s Ramen。

我无法选择……他们三个现在听起来都太好了！

我会问你…我脑子里的怪物…在这个美好的日子我应该吃什么？
